## Background

For an ordinal response $Y_i \in \{1, 2, \ldots, K\}$, the model introduces a
latent continuous variable $Z_i$ and cutpoints $\gamma_1 < \gamma_2 < \cdots < \gamma_{K-1}$:

$$
Y_i = k \iff \gamma_{k-1} < Z_i \leq \gamma_k
$$

where $Z_i = \mu(X_i) + \epsilon_i$ with $\epsilon_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0,1)$ and
$\mu(\cdot)$ is a BART ensemble.
